items.briefing:
Australian organisations should be aware that AI is making cyber attacks faster and harder to detect, particularly against older IT systems that may not receive regular updates — a common issue in education and training environments. Separately, AI-generated phishing emails have become so convincing they are outpacing current detection tools, meaning staff should not rely solely on security software to catch suspicious messages.

Microsoft has also issued emergency security patches following its recent Patch Tuesday update. If your organisation uses Windows devices or Microsoft software, ensure updates are applied as soon as possible.

**Tip:** If an email creates urgency or asks you to click a link, verify the request directly with the sender by phone before acting.

featured.title: AI speeds up cyber attacks on ageing systems, experts warn
featured.summary: Ageing technology is leaving critical services exposed as AI lets attackers exploit known weaknesses at machine speed, experts say.
